ὁρώμενος: ὁράω (mid.) — look at, gaze toward; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ὄχοι: ὀχός — holder; masc. nom. pl. (νηῶν ὄχοι ’holders of ships’, of a harbour)
ὑπήλυθε: ὑπέρχομαι — go in under, creep beneath; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὑπῆλθε)
ὑπεκλίνθη: ὑποκλίνομαι — sink down, lay oneself down under; aor. pass. 3 sg.
ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg. (ὥρῃ χειμερίῃ ’in the wintry season’)
ᾤδεε: οἰδέω — swell; plpf. 3 sg. with pres. force: ’was swollen’
ῥινοὶ: ῥινός — skin, hide; fem. nom. pl.
ῥινοὺς: ῥινός — skin, hide; fem. acc. pl.
ῥόθιον: ῥόθιος — rushing, surging; adj., neut. acc. sg. (κῦμα ... ῥόθιον ’the surging wave’)
ῥόχθει: ῥοχθέω — roar, dash noisily (of surf); impf. 3 sg.
ῥῖγος: ῥῖγος — chill, frost, cold; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ῥῖνάς: ῥίς — nose, nostril (distinct from ῥινός ’skin, hide’); fem. acc. pl.
βάλῃ: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. subj. 3 sg., tmesis ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’, in a purpose clause · also plain (no tmesis), ’strike, hit’ + acc., in a clause of fearing with μή: μή πώς μ’ ... βάλῃ ’lest it strike me’
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’)
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: τρίτον ἦμαρ ’the third day’ (τέλεσ’ Ἠώς ’Dawn completed the third day’)
χεῦ: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., elided (χεῦ’ = χεῦε), idiomatic of heaping up a mound: ’heaped up’ (τύμβον χεῦε ’raised a tomb’) · also of sleep poured over the eyes, the standard onset-of-sleep formula: ὕπνον ἐπ’ ὄμμασι χεῦ’ ’poured sleep upon his eyes’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’
